description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: A client-generated token to ensure that the request is idempotent. The token must be unique for each request. It is case-sensitive and can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters.
